name: TRAY DRYER OVEN
desc: Industrial Drying Oven Tray Dryer engineered for highly efficient and uniform thermal drying of bulk materials. Built with a high-grade SS304 internal and external enclosure accommodating 12 heavy-duty trays, integrating a powerful forced-air circulation system.
features: Cross-tray uniform forced air draft to eliminate cold/hot spots
Up to 100°C highly regulated stable thermal footprint
Semi-Automatic Digital Temperature Controller cum Indicator
Premium Corrosion-Resistant Stainless Steel (SS304 Grade Body)

specifications.Tray Size Dimensions: Large-Scale 800 mm x 400 mm workspace area per tray
specifications.Material of Construction: Premium Corrosion-Resistant Stainless Steel (SS304 Grade Body)
specifications.Maximum Operational Temp: Up to 100°C highly regulated stable thermal footprint
specifications.Air Distribution Method: Forced-Air Circulation via dynamically balanced blower fan
specifications.Automation Control Grade: Semi-Automatic Digital Temperature Controller cum Indicator
